title.narrative: Guangxi Regional Cooperation and Integration Promotion Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The Guangxi Regional Cooperation and Integration Promotion Investment Program will help the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region (GZAR) of the People's Republic of China (PRC) implement its strategies and action plans for regional cooperation and integration (RCI) with countries of the Association of the Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), particularly the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS).

Status of Implementation Progress: For Loan 3501, as of 20 September 2023, the cumulative contract award (CA) and cumulative disbursement (DB) reached $59.27 million or 89.2% of the net loan amount, and $65.18 million or 98% of the net loan amount, respectively. The FI loan 3508 was financially closed on 9 December 2022 with a final disbursement of $60.00million and loan savings of $3.65 million was cancelled.
